page.layout: One printed page, one text column in roman type with a title block above it: a centred title, a centred author line, a centred salutation line, then the running text in full width below. No margin notes. A page number appears at the top right above the title.

main_text.head: LEONI ALLATIO SVO,
main_text.p: BIna illa Opuscula, quæ nuper ad me misisti, Clarissime Leo, nostri sæculi Literatorum decus, & ornamentum; Vnum Iohannis Henrici Hottingeri Tigurini inscriptum: Disputatio Apologetica de euidenti Ecclesia Orientalis, & Occidentalis, tam in dogmatibus, quam in ritibus dissensu; Alterum, cui titulus est: Exercitatio Historico-Theologica de Ecclesia Græcanica hodierna, M. Eliæ Veielij Vlmensis, legi, atque perlegi, eamque præsertim partem, in qua vterque scripta mea exagitat circa variarum Syrorum, Arabumque Christianarum Sectarum consensum tam inter se, quam cum Ecclesia Romana de ritibus, & dogmatibus, quæ nos inter & Reformatos in controuersiam vocantur. Id enim vnum est, quod a me planè exigis, & cuius gratia Opuscula illa pro tua in me humanitate, & beneuolentia misisti. Tuis itaque morem gerens iussibus, eruditissime Leo, paucis ape-

page.notes: Title block: the first line reads "LEONI ALLATIO" with "SVO," on the next line; the printed title is set as one head and the salutation names are plain lines. The salutation line "Abrahamus Ecchellensis" and "S. P. D." are set in italic/spaced type and are not headings. The word "ape-" at the foot is the catchword and is also the start of the broken word "apertè"-type line; it is kept as printed. Spelling and long s are as printed (s rendered as s). The printed hyphen in "Historico-Theologica" is kept. Two blank marks and a small dot near the lower left are specks, not text.
